auxiliary_region_bank: All official boxes from canonical train split only; fixed across few-shot settings.
auxiliary_supervision_boundary: The auxiliary bank uses additional train-split image style labels and region boxes. Random-box banks use exactly the same source images, style labels, and number of anchors.
anchor_selection: deterministic cosine farthest-point sampling with equal anchors per style

selection.metric: mean paired validation accuracy delta minus 0.5 sample SD
selection.test_loader_policy: No test loader, features, dense tokens, or logits may be constructed during selection.
